mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ld_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_type = #{nodeType}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ld_unified_knowledge_nodes WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ld_disease_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_type = 'disease'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ld_disease_knowledge_nodes WHERE node_type = 'pest'

SELECT n1.node_name as cropName, COUNT(n2.id) as varietyCount FROM ld_knowledge_nodes n1 LEFT JOIN ld_knowledge_nodes n2 ON n2.parent_id = n1.node_id AND n2.node_type = 'variety' WHERE n1.node_type = 'crop' GROUP BY n1.node_id, n1.node_name ORDER BY varietyCount DESC
SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count FROM ld_unified_knowledge_nodes WHERE category IN ('病害', '虫害', '非生物胁迫') AND status = 1 GROUP BY category

SELECT category, node_type as nodeType, COUNT(*) as count FROM ld_unified_knowledge_nodes WHERE category IN ('病害', '虫害', '非生物胁迫') AND status = 1 GROUP BY category, node_type ORDER BY category, node_type
SELECT node_type as nodeType, COUNT(*) as count FROM ld_disease_knowledge_nodes GROUP BY node_type
